svg.title: Rat · Black
svg.desc: Large black laboratory rat with deep dark fur, upright robust body, broad muzzle, large hind feet, and substantial tail. Biological basis: Black rat coat color reflects eumelanin-rich hair while the characteristic large-bodied Rattus norvegicus proportions remain visible.
